The verbose listing adds four columns to the right of Mem Usage. A
header of it looks like this, with the rule under it:

Image Name                     PID Session Name        Session#    Mem Usage Status          User Name                                              CPU Time Window Title
========================= ======== ================ =========== ============ =============== ================================================== ============ ============
notepad.exe                   4242 Console                    1     12,345 K Running         EXAMPLE\user                                            0:00:01 Untitled - Notepad

Status is Running, Suspended, Not Responding or Unknown. CPU Time is the
processor time the process has used since it started, and Window Title
is N/A for a process without a window.
